svg.title: Monthly whole-atmosphere CO2 growth rate from OCO-2 (GRESO) with emissions and ENSO, 2015-2026
svg.desc: Line chart of the monthly CO₂ growth rate measured by OCO-2 from 2015 to mid-2026, swinging between about 1.3 and 3.9 ppm per year with peaks in January 2016 and October 2023 after El Niño events, while fossil and land-use emissions stay nearly flat at about 11.5 PgC per year above it. The gap between the two lines is the carbon taken up by land and ocean, and an ENSO index strip below shows El Niño and La Niña periods.
